meta.title: 优化内存分析功能性能
meta.body_summary: Optimize memory analysis functions by introducing timeouts, object limits, and simplified deep analysis to prevent 100% CPU utilization and system freezes.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor optimized memory analysis; bot flagged SIGALRM incompatibility; agent refactored to ThreadPoolExecutor, merged quickly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1527 changed lines, this is a medium-to-large edit by absolute volume, though most churn is in temporary test/doc files later removed. The core production change in memory.py is about 1000 lines of refactoring, fitting a moderate performance refactor. Merged quickly after addressing a bot-reported technical flaw.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] reported that the timeout mechanism using signal.SIGALRM only works in the main thread and on Unix, failing in daemon threads and on Windows.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent 100% CPU utilization and system freezes by introducing timeouts and object limits.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor initially used signal.SIGALRM, a Unix-only mechanism that fails in daemon threads; the agent iterated to use ThreadPoolExecutor for cross-platform timeout.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor[bot] identified the signal.SIGALRM cross-platform/threading flaw and reported it.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No reproducible benchmark or profiling data; performance claim is narrative.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Cursor responded to the bot report by refactoring the timeout mechanism in subsequent commits, replacing signal with ThreadPoolExecutor.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored memory analysis functions in app/helper/memory.py to limit object traversal, add configurable timeout via ThreadPoolExecutor, and sample objects to prevent 100% CPU spikes; temporary test and doc files were added and later removed.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: These files were added during iteration and removed in the final commit.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Implemented timeout/sampling/limits in memory.py using signal.SIGALRM.
Second commit: Added ThreadPoolExecutor-based timeout and test/documentation files.
Third commit: Removed temporary test and documentation files, leaving the production refactor.

review_signals.summary: Reported that signal.SIGALRM-based timeout fails in daemon threads and is Unix-only; recommended fix in Cursor.
review_signals.action_taken: Agent refactored to use ThreadPoolExecutor in subsequent commits.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with signal-based timeout implementation.
cursor[bot] posted a bug report within ~3 minutes.
Cursor agent pushed two more commits replacing signal with ThreadPoolExecutor and removing temporary files.
Maintainer merged after ~33 minutes without additional feedback.
